name: vid-skills
description: Model-agnostic, hands-free short-form video production: research → script → voice → HyperFrames motion graphics → sound design → render → publish. Usable as skills, MCP, CLI, library or a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.build: pnpm run gen && pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' run build
scripts.gen: tsx scripts/gen-limits-doc.ts && node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && node scripts/gen-prompts.mjs
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run gen && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run lint:skills
